只要有合适的技术，我们就有将低级生物提升至开智种族的方法了。

要提升物种；

£dot_green£打开未开智£planet£行星
£dot_green£选择管理选项卡
£dot_green£选中物种
£dot_green£点击设置权利
£dot_green£点击提升
texts.en:
Having researched the appropriate technology, we now have the means to Uplift lesser beings to sapience.

To uplift a Species;

£dot_green£ Open the Pre-Sapient £planet£ Planet
£dot_green£ Click the Management tab
£dot_green£ Select the Species
£dot_green£ Click on Set Rights
£dot_green£ Click on Uplift

The species will begin the uplift process, gaining full sapience once completed.
